title: High-spin and low-spin d⁶
caption: Fe²⁺ is d⁶. With weak-field water, Δo is smaller than the energy needed to pair electrons, so they spread out: high spin, four unpaired. With strong-field cyanide, Δo is large and all six pair in t₂g: low spin, none unpaired.
alt: Two octahedral splitting diagrams for Fe²⁺: [Fe(H₂O)₆]²⁺ high spin with four unpaired electrons, [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻ low spin with none.
description: [Fe(H₂O)₆]²⁺: t₂g with one pair and two singles, eg with two singles: four unpaired.
[Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻: t₂g fully paired, eg empty: none unpaired, diamagnetic.
